definitions.explanation: Fine particles of rock and mineral fragments ejected from a volcano during an eruption.

examples.japanese: {火山灰|かざんばい}が{降|ふ}っている。
{噴火|ふんか}のあと、{町|まち}は{火山灰|かざんばい}に{覆|おお}われた。
examples.english: After the eruption, the town was covered in volcanic ash.

examples.japanese: {鹿児島|かごしま}では{桜島|さくらじま}の{火山灰|かざんばい}が{日常的|にちじょうてき}に{降|ふ}るため、{住民|じゅうみん}は{対策|たいさく}に{慣|な}れている。
examples.english: In Kagoshima, volcanic ash from Sakurajima falls regularly, so residents are accustomed to dealing with it.

notes:
{火山灰|かざんばい} refers to fine particles of rock ejected during a volcanic eruption. A compound of {火山|かざん} (volcano) + {灰|はい} (ash). The reading uses {灰|ばい}, the on'yomi.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {火山灰|かざんばい}が{降|ふ}る: volcanic ash falls
- {火山灰|かざんばい}に{覆|おお}われる: to be covered in volcanic ash
- {火山灰|かざんばい}を{取|と}り{除|のぞ}く: to remove volcanic ash
- {火山灰|かざんばい}が{積|つ}もる: volcanic ash accumulates

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japan has many active volcanoes, so {火山灰|かざんばい} is a practical concern. In {鹿児島|かごしま}, {桜島|さくらじま} regularly deposits ash, and special collection bags ({克灰袋|こくはいぶくろ}) are distributed by the city.

RELATED WORDS:
- {噴火|ふんか}: volcanic eruption
- {火山|かざん}: volcano
- {溶岩|ようがん}: lava
